caption: The drawing depicts a decorative architectural detail featuring an ornamental, leaf-like motif positioned at the center of two converging, arch-like stone or plaster structures. The ornament itself is pale blue with gold edging and curling, acanthus-style shapes, topped with a small blue dot and ending at the bottom with a larger blue, circular element. The surrounding arches are rendered in a light, reddish-brown color with darker brown shading, suggesting the appearance of aged or weathered stone. The background is a light beige or off-white, and the artist's signature, "W. Kieckhoefel," is visible in the lower right corner.
title: Ceiling Decoration
